text:
eva_marketing: Hey runtime team — marketing is finalizing the launch post and we need the canonical artifacts from the recent benchmark run to justify our latency/cost claims. Can you help with a short checklist and share the raw traces?

Specifically we need:
- Per-model latency CDFs (p50/p90/p95/p99) for float32 and quantized variants
- Raw request/response traces (anonymized) and raw_payloads.json.gz (seed list)
- Exact invocation commands, env, and model hash used to reproduce (docker image / model checksum)
- Warmup profile (how many warmup requests, hotstart vs coldstart) and kv-cache behavior notes
- Any config that could affect tokenization or batching so we don't accidentally compare apples/oranges

Deadline: EOD Wed if possible — this will feed into the launch blog and a webinar slide. :eyes:

josh_runtime: Thanks — acked. We'll need to confirm which model variants you want published (float32 + two quantized levels ok?) and whether the CDFs should include cold-start tail or be steady-state only. Also: do you need raw traces with full tokens or redacted?

eva_marketing: Float32 + q8_0 and q4_1 would be perfect. CDFs should be steady-state (exclude the first 30 warmup seconds) — put a note in the caption about warmup policy. Traces should be token-level timings but please redact prompt content (we'll supply synthetic seed payloads if that helps).

micaela_sre: FYI we have retention policies — full trace logs older than 7 days get rotated. If you want the exact run artifacts preserved, ask for an export to the bench bucket. Also perf-ci-bot can snapshot profiles and upload to S3. Example fetch command for traces: 

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RUNTIME_KEY" \
  "https://perf.internal/api/v1/traces?run=2045678901" \
  -o traces-2045678901.tar.gz

josh_runtime: Perfect. We'll schedule a controlled rerun on dedicated capacity (to get clean steady-state numbers) and export: traces/, profiles/, raw_payloads.json.gz, env.txt (docker sha + model checksum), and run_config.json. Expected ETA: 36 hours. I'll post the S3 link when done.

perf-ci-bot: Artifacts for run 2045678901 queued. When export completes an upload message will be posted here with the S3 URI.

eva_marketing: Awesome — can you also attach a small README that states the methodology (how many tokens per request, batch sizes, concurrency, warmup steps) so the comms team can write the methodology blurb? Minimal legal will ask for that. :thumbsup:

josh_runtime: Will do. Quick note for comms: we run with continuous batching enabled, target batch size 16, concurrency 8, and 30s warmup. We'll include that and the exact commands. If anyone needs stricter reproducibility (same random seed for sampling models), tell me and we can lock inference RNG.

micaela_sre: If you need the upload sooner, ping me and I'll bump the job priority on the dedicated pool.

eva_marketing: Thanks everyone — leave it with us to review artifacts once uploaded. If we spot anything odd we'll open a small follow-up thread.
